responsibility: Verifies the snapshot map’s transactional behavior, covering basic rollback of inserts and overwrites, detection of invalid out-of-order rollback usage, and interaction between nested snapshots, commit, and later rollback.
same_name_distinction: This `tests.rs` is distinguished by transactional semantics, exercising snapshot creation, nesting, commit, rollback restoration, and invalid rollback ordering instead of ordinary collection insertion or lookup behavior.
